transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Monkey! You useless, flea-bitten ape! The horse is gone, the scripture-bags are gone, and the Master is weeping! You said you'd secure it before you left! Tripitaka is going to blame me, I just know it!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hold on, Pigsy! Calm down, you're not making sense. I tied the horse up just as we always do. It's a fine harness, with three loops around the tree. How could it have wandered off? The wind must have blown it into the river, or perhaps it's stuck in a deep rut. I'll fetch it right away!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Fine harness, my trotters! You tied it up as if you were holding it with a noodle! I can't believe you let this happen while I'm the one who'll bear the Master's ire! We don't even know if it was the wind, or some demon lurking about stole it! Now, he's weeping himself into oblivion and we're wasting time standing here arguing! Go find the horse and the scriptures, and hurry, or we're both in for a scolding!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Scolding? Scolding! You overgrown hog! Don't you ever say another word about scolding me! I'll find the horse and the scriptures and— No, wait! You stay here and guard the camp. I'll be back in the blink of an eye, faster than you can say 'pigsy'! I'll search the forest and bring back everything we need. Now, be a good pig and hold still!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A 'good pig,' you say? We'll see who's laughing when Tripitaka gives you a lashing for this mess! Go on, do your monkey magic, get whatever help you need to find them, and make it snappy! I'll keep an eye on the Master, but hurry up, or I'll be up to my ears in tears, and I don't fancy being the target of his sorrow because of your slip-up!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Nonsense! I'm off! Wait here, you irascible hog, or you'll have to answer to me! I'll have that horse back in no time, and if there's any lashing to be done, it'll be to you for your insolence! Watch the camp, and if you see any demons, don't be a ninny and run away! I'll deal with them once I get back!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Go on, then! While you're having your fun hopping around the forest, I'll be the one holding this camp together. Just make sure you bring back that horse and scriptures, or else it'll be both of us facing the music. You'd better fend off any demons you find yourself; don't expect me to do all your work for you later! And for heaven's sake, hurry up!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hog! I'll be back before you can say 'monstrous misadventure'! And if you're not here when I return, it'll be your hide! transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: You get moving, Monkey, and save the threats for your own reflection! I’ll take care of Master while you're away, and he'd better see that horse and scriptures back safe and sound, or it’ll be more than my hide that's at stake! Bring some extra bananas if you stumble upon any—I've got a feeling you’ll need something to distract the Master's gaze from your slip-up! Now, get going!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You overgrown hog, you're driving me bananas with all this nattering! I'm off to save the day, so watch the camp, watch the Master, and—above all—watch your own tongue! When I return, you'll see that the job is done, and done well. Now, stop your griping and—finally—shut your snout! I'll be back before you can say 'tenderized pork'!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Go on, then! Be the hero you think you are and bring back everything as fast as you can! transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
